title: Understanding Non-Response Bias
text: Non-response bias occurs when the individuals who do not respond to a survey differ in significant ways from those who do respond. Consider whether offering an incentive like extra credit completely eliminates the possibility of this bias.

hintAnswer: Incentives can increase participation but may not eliminate all biases.|Incentives completely eliminate all forms of bias.|Incentives have no effect on survey participation.
title: Evaluating the Impact of Incentives
text: Which of the following statements is true about the effect of incentives on survey participation?
choices: Incentives can increase participation but may not eliminate all biases.
Incentives can increase participation but may not eliminate all biases.|Incentives completely eliminate all forms of bias.|Incentives have no effect on survey participation.
Incentives completely eliminate all forms of bias.
